# <span id="aanchor0"></span> Create Security Groups

A FLOWCAL security group is a list of users that receive all the privileges that have been granted to the group. A user ID can be added to multiple groups to provide that user additional privileges.

User access is determined by the privileges specified for the user or their group. If access is granted at either the group or the user level, the selected users will have that access.

Security groups can only be created from the Group Access screen. User IDs must exist before they can be associated to a security group.

<div class="procedure">

To create a security group:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**, and select **Groups** within the **Security** group.
2.  Click **New**.
3.  Enter a new unique group ID and grant the applicable privileges.
4.  Edit the password; otherwise, the user will log in with the default password and will be prompted to change the password on initial log in.
5.  Click **Save**.
